mapper.select: SELECT team.team_id, team.name, team.create_time, team.create_user, team.uuid, team.status, creator.name as createUserName, team.modify_user, modifier.name as modifyUserName FROM team_tb team JOIN user_tb creator ON creator.user_id = team.create_user LEFT JOIN user_tb modifier on modifier.user_id = team.modify_user WHERE team.uuid = #{teamUuid}
